app.name: Camhive
app.tagline: Your cameras. Your footage stays home.
app.cloudDown: The Camhive cloud cannot be reached. Hives on your network keep working with your stored access; sharing, invitations and sign-in need the cloud.

auth.resetSent: If that e-mail has an account, a reset link is on its way (valid for one hour).
auth.loginIntro: Sign in to watch your cameras.
auth.registerIntro: Free for one hive. No card needed.

home.heroText: Camhive records your IP cameras on a computer in your home. Watch live and recorded video from anywhere and share access with your family, while every recording stays on your own disk.
home.f1Text: Footage is recorded to your own disk and is never stored in the cloud.
home.f2Text: Direct, encrypted peer-to-peer video on your phone or laptop, at home or on the go.
home.f3Text: Give family members access to single cameras, as viewer or operator, for as long as you like.
home.privacy: No cloud recording. No traffic limits. Recording keeps going even when the internet is down.

hives.title: Hives

hives.codeIntro: Type the code exactly as shown; it is valid for 10 minutes.

hives.waiting: Waiting for the hive to come online…

transport.title: Connection
transport.liveNote: Live video always travels peer to peer over WebRTC (through our TURN relay only when your network blocks direct connections). This path is for recordings, exports and settings.

reason.lan_ok: The hive answered on its local name.
reason.lan_failed: The local name did not answer; using the relay.
reason.lan_unavailable: The hive has not reported a local address yet.
reason.relay_unavailable: No relay is configured for this hive.

transport.rebindTitle: Your router may block the local name.
transport.rebindHelp: Many routers (Fritz!Box, pfSense, Pi-hole) refuse public names that point to local addresses. Everything works through the relay; for direct access add this domain to your router's DNS rebind exceptions:
transport.lnaNote: Chrome asks once for permission to reach devices on your local network; allow it to keep the direct path.
transport.removeHelp: Frees the hive slot of your plan at once. The hive is disconnected from the cloud and cannot reconnect; recordings stay on it. To use it again, run `hive claim` on it and claim it anew.
transport.confirmRemove: Remove hive “{{name}}” from your account? Its recordings stay on the device.

live.hiveOffline: The hive is offline. Live video needs the hive connected to the cloud.
live.evicted: Your session on this hive was ended: another device signed in with your account or an owner revoked it. Reload to start a new one.
live.localMode: Local mode: the cloud is unreachable, so live video goes straight to the hive on your network with your stored access.

plan.title: Plan
plan.upgradeSoon: Paid plans arrive with card payments shortly after the beta; until then plans are assigned by us and promo codes work.
plan.alwaysFree: Always free, on every plan: recording, viewing and export on your own network, unlimited cameras, security updates. Nothing is deleted when a plan ends.
plan.promoHelp: A code from a partner or a campaign; each code works once per account.
plan.promoRedeemed: Code redeemed. Your plan has been updated.
